description: This file defines TypeScript types and functions related to bundled plugin build entries, including their parameters, collection, listing, and dependencies.

methods.name: export function collectBundledPluginBuildEntries( collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Collects and returns an array of BundledPluginBuildEntry objects based on provided parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Lists and returns a record mapping plugin names to string identifiers based on provided parameters.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Retrieves and returns an array of strings representing build artifacts for bundled plugins.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists and returns an array of strings representing runtime dependencies for bundled plugins.
